title: Norman NDE 22146
content: I was riding my bike in the middle of the day in an area that had no trees (it was just planted farmland). There were no clouds I could see one hundred fifty yards full circle all the way around me. I remember helping an old man sit down under a tree in the grass and I was talking to him. We talked for a while, but I don’t remember what we talked about. I looked toward the ambulance and said that I have to help them get that body in the ambulance. I didn't know it was my body. I remember once in the ambulance it was moving and rocking and I had a hard time laying back down. I woke up at hospital asking where I was and what happened, I was knocked out for four hours.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening hit by a car I was hit by a car.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons
elements.At what time during the experience were: Totally alert, just like now when I'm typing.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: None until I had to help people put me into the ambulance.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will In the ambulance, I just went back into my body.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will In the ambulance, I just went back into my body. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best thing is that it happened. The worst is that I can't remember it all.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They didn't know what to say.
